recipes.name: Mocha Hazelnut Oatmeal
instructions: Add the oats, milk, cacao powder, instant coffee, and salt to a saucepan. Cook at a simmer for 7 to 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in the chocolate and maple syrup.
Divide the oatmeal between the bowls. Top with banana, yogurt, hazelnut butter, hazelnuts, and the some more chocolate. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk and yogurt that is fortified with calcium . † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store the oatmeal, without toppings, in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
